assertion: SEC enforcement against public companies and their subsidiaries collapsed to its lowest level on record in fiscal year 2026, with the regulator initiating just 16 actions - a 71% decline from the 56 brought in the prior year and the smallest annual tally since the Securities Enforcement Empirical Database began tracking data in fiscal year 2010.
measure: SEC enforcement actions against public companies SEED
independent_value: Report: 16 actions, -71% from 56, lowest in SEED FY2010-FY2026
reason: Scope (public companies and subsidiaries) is stated; agency-wide standalone actions fell only 22% (303 to 235), which the article omits.

assertion: The 16 actions initiated in fiscal year 2026 were less than half the prior SEED low of 37 actions recorded in fiscal year 2013 and 52 fewer than the 68 brought in fiscal year 2022, the first full year under the previous administration. It marked the weakest opening year of any new SEC administration since at least fiscal year 2013.
independent_value: Report p.2: 37 in FY2013; 68 in FY2022; lowest first full year of a new administration since at least FY2013 (73 FY2018, 51 FY2014)

assertion: Total monetary settlements in fiscal year 2026 reached $184 million - the lowest in SEED and more than $600 million below the prior year's total. The average settlement fell to $12 million, down 18% from the fiscal year 2025 average of $15 million, while the median dropped to $1 million, a 76% decline from the $4 million median the year before.
independent_value: Report p.1, p.6: $184M; avg $12M (-18% from $15M); median $1M (-76% from $4M); median is second-lowest (FY2015 $0.6M)

assertion: 99% of total monetary settlements in fiscal year 2026 consisted of civil penalties, the highest such share in SEED. Disgorgement and prejudgment interest totaled just $1 million for the year, the lowest on record and roughly $100 million below the next-lowest total recorded in fiscal year 2025.
independent_value: Report p.5: 99% civil penalties; $1M vs $108M in FY2025

assertion: Only 63% of settling defendants faced a monetary settlement at all, the lowest share since fiscal year 2010 and well below the fiscal year 2017 to 2025 average of 92%. No defendant in a public company or subsidiary action admitted guilt, the first time that has occurred since fiscal year 2021. Between fiscal year 2022 and fiscal year 2025, an average of 21 public company or subsidiary defendants per year had admissions of guilt.
independent_value: Report p.4, p.6, Appendix 2: 63% vs 92%; 0 admissions of 19 defendants; FY2022-25 average 21 (16,16,34,16)

assertion: Half of all fiscal year 2026 actions against public companies and subsidiaries involved Issuer Reporting and Disclosure allegations, up from 39% in fiscal year 2025. All civil actions brought in fiscal year 2026 carried Issuer Reporting and Disclosure allegations, the third consecutive year that figure stood at 100%.
independent_value: Report p.3: 50% vs 39%; 100% of civil actions third consecutive year

assertion: Fiscal year 2026 also marked the first year in SEED with no actions involving Foreign Corrupt Practices Act allegations, down from an average of 10% of actions annually between fiscal year 2017 and fiscal year 2025. The absence follows an executive order issued by the White House on February 10, 2025, pausing FCPA enforcement by the Department of Justice.
independent_value: Report p.3 and endnote 7: first FY without FCPA action; 10% average; Feb. 10, 2025 executive order

assertion: The SEC brought 25% of public company and subsidiary actions as civil actions, the highest percentage since fiscal year 2013 and more than double the 10% average recorded between fiscal year 2017 and fiscal year 2025. Three of the four civil actions brought in fiscal year 2026 were not resolved on the same day they were initiated, the second-highest such share in SEED behind fiscal year 2021. All 12 administrative proceedings, by contrast, were resolved on the day they were initiated.
independent_value: Report p.2, p.6, Appendix 1: 4 of 16 = 25%; 3 of 4 = 75% vs FY2021 86%; 12 of 12 admin same day
reason: Shares rest on only 4 civil actions.

assertion: Only 53% of defendants in settled actions had cooperation noted by the SEC, the lowest share since fiscal year 2014 and below the fiscal year 2017 to fiscal year 2025 average of 66%. In a notable change, 16% of settling defendants had cooperation noted with no accompanying monetary settlement - the highest share since fiscal year 2010.
independent_value: Report p.4: 53% vs 66% average, lowest since FY2014 (41%); 16%, highest since FY2010 (18%)

assertion: The report's research sample covers 1,065 enforcement actions initiated against 903 public companies and subsidiaries between October 1, 2009, and September 30, 2026.
independent_value: Report p.7: 1,065 actions, 903 public companies and subsidiaries, Oct. 1, 2009 to Sept. 30, 2026

assertion: In remarks delivered at the Conference on Financial Market Regulation on May 8, 2026, Atkins stated the SEC "no longer measure[s] the success of [its enforcement] program by the quantity of enforcement actions" brought.
speaker: Paul Atkins
measure: SEC Chair Atkins enforcement quantity speech
independent_value: Speech: 'we no longer measure the success of our program by the quantity of enforcement actions or the headlines that they generate'

assertion: "Under Chair Atkins, FY 2026 SEC enforcement against public companies and subsidiaries dropped to its lowest level since the start of SEED in FY 2010, significantly lower than prior post-transition years," said Choi in the report.
speaker: Stephen Choi
measure: SEC enforcement actions against public companies SEED
independent_value: Verbatim in the report's page 1 callout; substance confirmed by figures
